## Summary / 修改摘要

- What changed and why? / 修改了什么，为什么？
- Which product example or repository surface is affected? / 影响哪个产品示例或仓库区域？
- Affected framework, examples, and conditional lanes / 受影响的框架、示例及条件通道：

## Dependency and artifact impact / 依赖与产物影响

- Factory or CI firmware artifact impact / 出厂或 CI 固件产物影响：
- Managed-component additions, removals, or lock changes / 托管组件新增、删除或锁定变化：
- BSP source pin, version, and upstream review link / BSP 源码锁定、版本及上游评审链接：

## Evidence / 验证证据

- Final commit SHA / 最终提交 SHA：
- GitHub Actions run / GitHub Actions 运行：
- ESP-IDF version and configuration / ESP-IDF 版本与配置：

## Hardware boundary / 硬件验证边界

- [ ] Documentation-only; no hardware claim / 仅文档修改，不包含硬件结论
- [ ] Compile-only; hardware behavior is not claimed / 仅编译验证，不宣称硬件行为
- [ ] Tested on the exact board revision described below / 已在下述精确硬件版本测试

Board revision, peripherals, and observed result / 硬件版本、外设及观察结果：

## Remaining work / 剩余工作

- Remaining TODOs, hardware checks, or follow-up pull requests / 剩余 TODO、实板检查或后续 PR：

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] English and Simplified-Chinese first-party docs are synchronized / 第一方中英文文档已同步
- [ ] No generated build or managed-component output is committed / 未提交生成的构建或托管组件文件
- [ ] No credentials, private paths, or device identifiers are included / 不包含凭据、私有路径或设备标识
- [ ] Factory firmware and local component boundaries are preserved or explicitly justified / 已保持或明确论证出厂固件与本地组件边界
- [ ] BSP and managed-component pin changes include upstream evidence / BSP 与托管组件锁定变化已附上游证据
